original_test_intent: Verify every approved LAN adapter fits every supported PCIe slot without interference, every required RJ-45/SFP+ connection mates smoothly through ten cycles and link-state detection follows each supported cable transition.
original_method: Qualified operator uses a signed adapter-slot-port-cable matrix, installs cards with power removed and ESD controls, captures fit/clearance, performs ten labeled cable cycles per port and only vendor-approved hot-plug actions while optional OS/BMC observers record transitions.
manual_activity: Qualified operator handles every card/cable/transceiver, performs ten cycles and judges fit/interference; agent may only collect optional electronic link evidence.
required_inputs: Approved NIC model/PN, bracket, slot/riser/chassis support matrix
Per-port RJ-45/SFP+ cable/transceiver identities and mating specification
Service manual, power removal/ESD and mounting requirements
Vendor statement distinguishing supported cable/transceiver hot-plug from forbidden card hot-plug
Qualified operator, per-cycle media/checklist, independent management and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Remove power before PCIe adapter installation or relocation
Use ESD controls and never force card/cable/transceiver insertion
Do not hot-plug a PCIe card; execute only documented RJ-45/SFP+ cable/transceiver actions
Stop on interference, abnormal gap/force, latch failure, damage, cable strain, BMC/network outage or failed boot
No automatic reseat, power-cycle or continuation after damage
agent_execution_scope: Index operator evidence and optionally collect time-aligned PCI/link/driver/counter/log status
Map every cycle to exact adapter/slot/port/cable/transceiver identity
Do not touch hardware, infer tactile quality, authorize unsupported hot-plug or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide support/hot-plug/mating specifications and safe matrix
Ensure operator and independent recovery coverage
Review every slot/port/cycle result and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: defining card/cable operations are physical and not remotely executable; electronic reads can only corroborate link detection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual power-off ESD-controlled adapter installation plus ten labeled RJ-45/SFP+ mating cycles per approved port; optional read-only link observer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All adapter models, all supported PCIe slots, every port,10 cycles, RJ-45/SFP+ hot plug and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a Cartesian matrix ledger with per-slot installation evidence and ten numbered per-port cable cycles with synchronized link transitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, cycle accounting, explicit hot-plug boundary and stop/recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; OS logs do not prove fit, smooth insertion or physical interference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated mating causes connector wear; SFP+ latches and module thermal state differ from RJ-45, and link detection timing depends on partner/driver.

project_override_considerations: Only approved slot/model/port combinations and vendor-supported cable/transceiver hot-plug are exercised; an open-ended `all` matrix is resolved before handling hardware.
expected_evidence: Operator/date, service/ESD/power record and matrix revision
Per-slot installed/clearance/bracket/cover/cable photos and fit notes
Ten numbered per-port plug/unplug observations including force/gap/latch/damage
Time-aligned link up/down/negotiation evidence for each supported cable action
Final restored assembly/network/BMC health, damage/recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Mechanical fit, repeated smooth cable mating and correct link detection are coherent. Exact matrix and hot-plug support are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator, hardware matrix, service procedure and vendor support can be supplied; the case is manual rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Makes the all-model/all-slot/all-port and ten-cycle scope auditable while explicitly separating safe cable hot-plug from forbidden PCIe card hot-plug.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case has two distinct wear/failure surfaces: card-to-slot mechanical compatibility and cable/transceiver mating/link detection. A card can fit one riser but collide in another, and a connector can link initially yet develop latch/contact issues across cycles. The evidence ledger must therefore preserve the full adapter-slot-port-cable combination rather than aggregate successes.
